events.event_name: FIT × Waldorf Astoria New York: Celebration of NYFW
events.brand: Waldorf Astoria New York × Fashion Institute of Technology
events.address: Waldorf Astoria New York, 301 Park Ave, New York, NY 10022
events.what_it_is: A public fashion exhibition in the Waldorf Astoria New York's Peacock Alley and Lexington Avenue corridor vitrines spotlighting evening gowns by emerging FIT designers, with Art Deco, craftsmanship and hoop-dress construction themes.
events.what_is_free: Viewing the fashion exhibition is free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Waldorf Astoria New York's current official experiences page explicitly lists FIT × Waldorf Astoria New York: Celebration of NYFW as open to the public September 1–20. Fashionista independently describes the vitrines exhibition as free. The official listing does not publish dedicated daily exhibition hours, so no hours are invented here.
events.practical_notes: Open to the public through Sunday, September 20 at the Waldorf Astoria New York. Dedicated exhibition hours are not stated on the official listing; verify hotel access before making a special trip.
